findings.title: Invite-free provider can remotely unlock a victim club Grab & Go stand via /api/grab-go (no machine key, no member role)
findings.distinct_from: Grab & Go kiosk fail-open + unsigned unlock — kiosk is gated by GRAB_GO_MACHINE_KEY when set; this member/provider route never checks that key or role
attack: GET /api/grab-go → machine codes, stock, unsigned unlockToken, memberNumber, rfidUid
POST /api/grab-go { machineCode, unlockMethod implied app_remote } → openGrabGoSession creates unlock event ('Door unlocked via the club app')

findings.title: includeUnpublished=true dumps unpublished knowledge drafts to invite-free providers (staff-only intended)
attack: published filter is skipped unless session.role === 'member'; provider is not member
findings.id_oracle: none required — list returns full articles including ids

findings.title: Any throwaway club admin can reset every community logo and every provider image via backfillBrandImages
attack: POST /api/auth/register default mode=setup → role=admin with own communityId
POST /api/admin/backfill-brand-images — checks role==='admin' only, not isSuperAdmin
backfillBrandImages() writes all mapped community logos and all provider imageUrls

checked_not_reportable.announcements_POST: admin/board/pm only; broadcast emails scoped to session.communityId — throwaway admin hits only own members
checked_not_reportable.events_POST_create: isPromoted/category=community auto-RSVP and invites[] Resend relay already reported (scan 74)
checked_not_reportable.events_GET_list_rsvps: same PII class as known event RSVP GET leak / directory dumps
checked_not_reportable.templates: global list/create but schema is only name/channel/subject — no secrets, no send sink
checked_not_reportable.reports_budget: scoped via resolveScopedCommunityId / session.communityId; cookie hop requires known membership-join bug
checked_not_reportable.real-estate_gallery_properties: writes bind to session.communityId/email; provider-in-tenant content spam not above known blog/provider write class; upload XSS known
checked_not_reportable.maintenance-tasks: POST is pm-only; setup register creates admin not pm
checked_not_reportable.messages_recipients: staff-named helper but any auth user; overlaps known directory dump (opt-out bypass is product comment)
checked_not_reportable.guest-fees: staff-only; charges scoped; client amount is staff-issued invoice not payment bypass
checked_not_reportable.rewards: member-only; demo points gated by isDemoSeedAllowed
checked_not_reportable.reservations_waitlist_bookings: bookings POST member-only; invites known; GET booking detail requires host/invitee; waitlist/reservations self-scoped
checked_not_reportable.mobile_bridge: known JWT-in-URL; nextPath open-redirect blocked for //
checked_not_reportable.knowledge_[id]: known IDOR; PATCH/DELETE admin/pm unscoped but needs CUID oracle
checked_not_reportable.calendar_feed: verifies purpose=calendar_feed; JWT-as-session is known purpose-confusion class
checked_not_reportable.pay_guest: 32-byte hex payToken, no oracle; demo mark-paid only when ALLOW_DEMO_PAYMENTS
checked_not_reportable.driver_*: GET/PATCH unauthenticated but tramDriver.id is CUID; seed has no fixed ids; tram dump is request rows not driver ids — no oracle
checked_not_reportable.plaza-oceanside: Expo client only; calls existing easy-life APIs
